description: This file defines the NewtonsoftJsonCodec class, which implements serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and type filtering of objects using Newtonsoft.Json within the Orleans framework. It provides mechanisms to serialize objects to JSON, support copying and filtering based on type selectors, and integrates with Orleans' serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
classes.description: A codec for serializing and deserializing objects to JSON using Newtonsoft.Json within the Orleans framework, supporting copying and type filtering.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value to the wire format as a JSON string, including type information.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string from the wire format back into an object of the appropriate type.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported by this codec for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object via JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: IsSupportedType (IGeneralizedCopier)
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for copying.
